# WallTracer: code map

<!-- generated by APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py · 2026-11-09 · code 44f3d0069fc7 · regenerate after every change -->

**Read this first, then open only the files it points to.** Line numbers are where definitions start; read
around them with an offset instead of whole files.

**What it is:** Pin a picture to your real wall with your Quest headset, put the controllers down and trace it with a pencil. Hide it with one button to check your lines.
**Live:** https://walltracer.anvil.app · **Repo:** github.com/arkulinskis/walltracer · **Layout:** native Anvil Forms · **Deploy:** master
**Guide** (workflow, design rules, product knowledge): `walltracer/.claude/skills/walltracer/SKILL.md`

## How to change it

- **New page**: copy a similar `client_code/Pages/<Name>/` (form_template.html + __init__.py), register it in
  `client_code/router.py` (`PAGES`, `_form()`, and `NAV` for the menu). Address = `#name/arg`.
- **New list**: a RepeatingPanel in the page template + `client_code/Items/<Name>/`. **Dialog**: `client_code/Dialogs/<Name>/` opened with `alert(...)`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in the matching `server_code` module (see *Server*), called with `state.call("name", ...)`.
- **New table/column**: `anvil.yaml` → `db_schema` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert); update the server-test mock.
- **Drawing/media/canvas**: a JavaScript engine in `theme/assets/` wrapped by a Python module or a `Components/` form.
- **Styles**: `theme/assets/app.css` (colour tokens at the top; rules in APP_MAKER/design/README.md).
- **Check**: `python tools/check.py` → ALL CHECKS PASSED; UI: `python -I tools/ui_test.py` (Docker Desktop running).
- **Deploy**: commit as arkulinskis (+ Co-Authored-By) and `git push` (master unless apps.json says branch-first).
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms, Contact developer (arkvital.com), Parent company (addanapp.com).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py walltracer` refreshes this map.

## Notes

<!-- NOTES: hand-written, kept when the map is regenerated -->
- **Forms vs JavaScript:** pages, lists, menus and dialogs are Forms. Engines stay JS in theme/assets: `wt.js` (window.WT:
  settings, looks/WT.process, overlay, readPicture, lettering maker modal, WT.store = account via server or this browser via
  IndexedDB, ids `d_...`), `wt-screens.js` (the editor `edit` and the WebXR/practice-room `trace` screen, moved unchanged
  from the old pages; mounted by `Components/Screen`), `ark-music.js`. `wt-kit.js` gives the engines the old `UI.*`
  (api through `window.WT_BRIDGE`, toast/confirm through `WT.host`, UI.modal, UI.page/mountScreen, [data-go]).
- **Python <-> engines:** only through `client_code/wt.py`. `wt.store("list")`, `wt.store("create", {...})` etc. wait on
  the engine promise via `WT.settle` (JSON {ok, value|error}; never raises) and toast errors. `state.set_me` keeps
  `UI.me` in sync (WT.store decides account vs browser by it).
- **Engine promises must settle:** the lettering modal and the file picker now resolve `null` on close/cancel (small
  wt.js edits), otherwise a Python click handler would wait forever.
- **Trace is chromeless:** `router.CHROMELESS` -> Shell adds `no-chrome`; Shell also sets `page-<name>` (old page CSS
  like `.page-trace .ui-main` relies on it). Edit/Trace pages set `waits = True`: the screen sets UI_READY.
- **Visitors see the main menu** (they can trace without an account); the phone tab bar is members only.
- `.ic` is the icon-mask class: the studio tile icon box is `.st-ic`. List grids live on `.anvil-role-<role> > div`.
- Headset (WebXR) can't be tested locally: the smoke test opens the practice-room intro only.
<!-- /NOTES -->

## Tools

- `tools/assets.py`: Refresh the theme assets' cache-busting hashes in anvil.yaml (and icons.css).
- `tools/build_icons.py`: Write theme/assets/icons.css from the icon table in theme/assets/lh-kit.js (UI.ICONS).
- `tools/check.py`: Everything that must pass before pushing. Ends with ALL CHECKS PASSED.
- `tools/make_icons.py`: Make the PNG app icons from theme/assets/icon.svg (headless Chrome draws them).
- `tools/ui_test.py`: Run the app for real in the open-source Anvil App Server (Docker) and drive it with headless Chrome.
